'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2025 India–Pakistan conflict]]
**The [[Indian Air Force]] strikes [[Pakistan Air Force]] [[PAF Base Nur Khan|Base Nur Khan]] in [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]], [[Pakistan]], with [[cruise missile]]s with reports of multiple explosions. The [[Pakistan Armed Forces]] says the airbase has come under attack from [[air-to-surface missile]]s and that air defences are engaging hostile targets over Pakistani airspace. [https://www.news18.com/india/india-pakistan-live-updates-operation-sindoor-pahalgam-terror-attack-ind-pak-loc-tension-missile-drone-attack-liveblog-9330275.html (News18)]
**Pakistan closes its [[airspace]] to all non-military flights saying the [[Indian Armed Forces]] has launched [[ballistic missile]]s at the country. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/operation-sindoor-live-updates-jammu-and-kashmir-pahalgam-terror-attack-india-pakistan-tensions-missile-drones-attack/liveblog/121014316.cms (''The Times of India'')]
*[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
**Nine soldiers are injured in an [[improvised explosive device]] explosion in the Shijaiyah neighborhood of [[Gaza City]], [[Palestine]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/israel-hamas-war/article/israeli-airstrikes-kill-23-in-gaza-as-outcry-over-aid-blockade-grows/ (CTV News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Bayesian (yacht)|Sinking of the ''Bayesian'' yacht]]
**A 39-year-old [[Netherlands|Dutch]] diver dies during preparations for the [[marine salvage|salvage]] operation of the ''[[Bayesian (yacht)|Bayesian]]'' [[yacht]] which sunk in 2024. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2566629-nederlandse-duiker-omgekomen-bij-berging-gezonken-superjacht-bij-sicilie (NOS)]
*At least 62 people are killed following floods caused by heavy rain along [[Lake Tanganyika]] in [[South Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/eastern-congo-flooding-tanganyika-2920667256de00bcfe5a6dfbe4414bf1 (AP News)]
*Six people are killed and six others are injured when a [[Sri Lanka Air Force]] [[Bell 212]] helicopter crashes into the [[Maduru Oya]] river in [[Sri Lanka]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/six-killed-sri-lanka-helicopter-crash-military-5119446 (CNA)]

'''International relations'''
*[[France–Poland relations]]
**[[France|French]] [[President of France|president]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] and [[Poland|Polish]] [[Prime Minister of Poland|prime minister]] [[Donald Tusk]] signs a treaty committing both sides to mutual assistance. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20250509-france-and-poland-sign-new-cooperation-treaty-including-key-mutual-defence-clause (France24)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/poland-france-commit-helping-each-other-case-military-threat-2025-05-09/ (Reuters)] 
*[[Hungary–Ukraine relations]]
**The [[Security Service of Ukraine|Security Service]] of [[Ukraine]] arrests two people on suspicion of [[espionage|spying]] for [[Hungary]] in [[Zakarpattia Oblast]], which is home to an [[ethnic minority]] of over 150,000 [[Hungarians in Ukraine|Hungarians]]. The [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Hungary)|Hungarian foreign ministry]] expels two [[List of diplomatic missions of Ukraine|Ukrainian diplomats]] in response to the allegations, characterizing them as [[anti-Hungarian sentiment#Ukraine|anti-Hungarian]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ukraine-hungary-espionage-0408db8aa78341e9a9a52f99c5f3400b (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*In [[cricket]], the [[2025 Pakistan Super League]] is suspended indefinitely due to the ongoing [[2025 India–Pakistan conflict|military action]] between [[India]] and [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.skysports.com/cricket/news/12123/13364623/pakistan-super-league-postponed-indefinitely-due-to-military-action-between-india-and-pakistan (Sky Sports)]
